# Issue344 owned Windows complete-package QA — SOURCE proposal

This bundle is not deployment, npm publication, a successful Windows run, or Dell Excel acceptance. The management owner supplies only exact source/license artifacts after the normal complete OpenClaw build/package and exact focused native 668-unit + two-owned-fixture proof have passed. The closed generic eligibility schema binds four immutable source/build proof hashes and rejects unknown top-level/nested private fields. It fixes deploymentReady=false and the canonical gate as pending separate live acceptance. Missing hashes, unfinished required source/focused-native gates, missing owned-fixture cases, incomplete source-policy bundled plugin set, or a placeholder eligibility receipt are refused before installation.

The full private WindowsSlotOperations module, target guards/hostname/principal/launcher paths, task/process observations, NewContext/actions/witness/phase code are **not included**. This generic non-actuating test subset is not a deployment-helper change or acceptance.

## Parent-only materialization and transfer

Integrate this entire reviewed bundle at `.github/issue344-package-qa/` and the byte-identical workflow at `.github/workflows/issue344-package-qa.yml`, on the new branch `source/issue344-package-qa-20261010`. A push limited to this exact QA branch registers the alias workflow; its main job is guarded `github.event_name == workflow_dispatch`, so registration does not run package QA or mutate the default branch. Parent then manually dispatches that exact source branch. The workflow verifies its actual Git-object bytes against the reviewed mirror after forcing LF checkout. No integration or dispatch is performed by this proposal.

1. Complete and independently verify final source package and focused native lane; canonical all/GUI remains a separate live-activation gate and may be pending during this disposable package QA; fill every actual value in the input template, including a newly written eligibility receipt. Explicitly review all public inputs as source/license-only and sanitized. Proof receipts are projected through strict generic source/build-QA primitive allowlists, bound to immutable private original-file hashes. Included status fields are unchanged; raw logs/XML/environment, local paths and actual Dell task/process/companion/reservation/config/activation metadata are excluded. This is not an exhaustive generic sanitizer; the parent reviews the actual public bytes.
2. Allocate a NEW excluded management temporary lease and declare retention/cleanup before copying large tars. Run `node prepare-public-inputs.mjs <actual-inputs.json> <new-lease/prepared>` with exact Node24.19. The new bundle has three unchanged tars and five JSON proofs. Unknown/pending values fail; no GitHub write occurs.
3. Only the management owner may run `node Upload-Issue344QaPrereleaseInputs.mjs <prepared/prepared-inputs.json> <new-lease/upload-journal>`. It uses normal authenticated `gh` on **shannon0430/openclaw**, creates one internal QA prerelease pinned to the exact source commit, uploads each fixed-name asset once with no clobber, downloads and rehashes each actual asset, then uploads the ID/hash manifest LAST. It creates only the explicit unofficial, non-production prerelease with `--latest=false`, no discussion and no npm publication. It never dispatches CI. Durable intent is fsynced before every write. Existing journal, failed upload, ambiguous create/readback, or changed IDs => stop; reconcile the same action read-only, never rerun or use a new journal to evade single-flight.
4. The owner reads `parent-dispatch-inputs.json`, integrates the exact frozen workflow/source and dispatches that one branch with the actual four scalar IDs/hashes. A read-only `contents:read` + `actions:read` Actions token is used only in the transfer step, never inherited by npm. Every asset is fetched by numeric ID and actual SHA256, not latest/tag lookup; exact preexisting tag is refused before create and the actual Git tag (bounded annotated-tag dereference) is independently bound to the final source commit; API prerelease/non-draft/target/asset membership and actual focused native green and canonical activation dispatch/workflow metadata are rechecked. Canonical metadata pins dispatch head27bbe and source-ref891ef separately; a pending canonical lane is recorded honestly, not counted as QA-green or used as a serial installation blocker. Token is not forwarded to the signed HTTPS asset host.
5. Download the resulting Actions artifacts once; verify actual run/source/proposal/transfer hashes and seal inventory before considering future activation. Artifacts contain all hidden inventory files. The expanded output is source/license-only and not installed anywhere live.

GitHub release assets are the supported parent upload/download path. The REST Actions-artifact API does not upload arbitrary local artifacts; `upload-artifact` is used only inside the authorized Actions job. The original unfrozen draft design was **explicitly replaced by the parent** because draft listings can require push access. The selected public-fork **internal QA prerelease** is clearly marked unofficial/non-production, `prerelease=true`, `make_latest=false`, no discussion, with only reviewed source/license bytes. Read-only Actions acquisition is still measured, not assumed: any 403/404 or ID/hash drift fails before installation; no credential/scope fallback or silent release mutation is implemented.

## Retention and failure ownership

Management source tars/verified native root remain leased to their original owner. Prepared copies and upload readback files are reproducible work: uploader removes each verified readback immediately but keeps hashes and journal. After actual Actions artifacts are independently verified and the parent releases the lease, remove only that declared generated copy root; original source/receipt/native leases are not this bundle's cleanup authority. Internal QA prerelease assets remain until their owner explicitly closes that transfer retention; no delete action is included.

Windows owns one GUID root under LocalAppData Temp on C:\; it writes an ownership receipt and retains every failed/outcome-unknown state. Native fixture files clean only their own exact leaves as authored. No recursive failure cleanup or retries. Successful expanded root is uploaded with hidden files and retained until artifact handover, then ephemeral runner disposal handles that runner. Evidence is outside the seal inventory, and result receipts explicitly deny live/Excel acceptance.

## Evidence categories

Local checks here: Node syntax, inert actual manifest/projection seams, workflow actionlint, and portable PowerShell7 parser checks only. No helper semantic acceptance is asserted. Required future Windows5.1/native/package/transfer runs are **unrun** until the owner dispatches and verifies them. Canonical all/GUI/no-skips is still required separately before any LIVE acceptance; this package-only run never makes deploymentReady=true. Source review is not proof of prerelease readability, normal installation, ABI on Windows, full expanded seal acceptance, real task fences, or Excel behavior.
